in_marathi.name: Niravika
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Liberation from sorrow
in_marathi.long_meaning: Niravika हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Niravika is derived from the Sanskrit word 'nir' meaning liberation and 'avika' meaning free from sorrow. This name is often given to girls to signify hope and deliverance from pain and suffering.
